title: comfort_band docstring says the climate slider's maximum sits one degree above the ceiling; it equals the ceiling
claim: comfort_band.py's module docstring states, in the present tense, that the climate entity's slider has 'its own maximum sitting one degree *above* the configured ceiling'; the real HeatPumpOptimizerClimate publishes max_temp equal to the configured max_temperature (overshoot 0.0 °C).
mechanism: climate.py:124 sets _attr_max_temp = config.max_temperature since v5.1.7 removed the + 1 (its own comment at climate.py:110 says so); the comfort_band bullet still describes the old slider as current, so a reader of comfort_band alone believes the slider can still store a target above the ceiling.

evidence.contention_note: other finder seats running on the shared box; count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: climate.EntryConfig.from_mapping wrapped (mock.patch.object, --perturb) to hand the entity max_temperature + 1, the pre-v5.1.7 slider

metric_definition: stale_rows = 1 when HeatPumpOptimizerClimate max_temp minus the configured max_temperature differs from the docstring's +1.0 °C, else 0.
phenomenon_property: A docstring that describes another component's current behaviour in the present tense matches what that component does at the same ref.

null_control.note: the instrument reads the docstring as true when the slider does overshoot

proposed_fix_scope: Rewrite the bullet in the past tense or drop the history (C4): the slider now offers exactly the band (climate.py:110-124).
